from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DocumentRecord(BaseModel):
    """One legal document found in the collection."""
    title: str = Field(description="The title or header of the legal document")
    document_type: str = Field(description="The type of document (e.g., 行政判决书，行政再审裁定书)")
    cause_of_action: str | None = Field(description="The cause of action or legal classification listed in the document (e.g., 行政行为 - 行政补偿)")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[DocumentRecord]
